description: Which vendors startups actually use for a job, counted from software stacks shared on Proven by portfolio companies in investor networks (about 2,700 companies). Use it when someone building a product asks which provider to pick (auth, database, email API, payments, error monitoring, CRM...). Returns vendors ranked by companies_using, with Proven Score and deal. Only vendors listed on Proven; companies are never named.

need.description: The job in plain words, e.g. "transactional email API", "auth for a Next.js app", "Postgres hosting".
